approach.title: Approach
approach.intro: A production-first method: start from the business need, make the constraints explicit, then choose the AI building blocks and the API layer with an observability and deployment strategy defined from the outset.

steps.title: Business need analysis
steps.detail: Use case, criticality, expected service level, available data, legal constraints, scope and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: Model choice: API or local
steps.detail: Trade-offs between cost, latency and privacy. Availability, governance, GPU constraints, fallback strategy and degraded modes.

steps.title: Embeddings strategy
steps.detail: Granularity, chunking, versioning, evaluation, update handling and source quality.

steps.title: Vector database
steps.detail: Storage choice, indexes, filtering, tenant isolation, retention, performance and cost.

steps.title: API layer
steps.detail: FastAPI and REST, authentication, rate limiting, schemas, idempotency, traceability and stable contracts.

steps.title: Observability
steps.detail: Structured logs, metrics, traces, and quality tracking: prompt version, retrieval relevance, observed drift.

steps.title: Deployment
steps.detail: CI/CD, environments, secrets management, scaling, observability and operational runbooks.

approach.teaser: I start from the business need and the real constraints before picking a single piece of technology. Cost, latency, privacy and operability are decided up front, not after go-live.
